SELECT
FROM city_cost WHERE del_yn = 'N'
AND country = #{country}
ORDER BY country, city

SELECT

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_goal (user_id, title, departure, destination, is_domestic, style, start_date, end_date, total_budget, status, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{departure}, #{destination}, #{isDomestic}, #{style}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{totalBudget}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N')
mapper.sql: goal_id, user_id, title, departure, destination, is_domestic, style, start_date, end_date, total_budget, places, benefits AS products, package_id, status, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM travel_goal WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND goal_id = #{goalId}

SELECT
FROM travel_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY goal_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_goal SET places = CASE WHEN destination <> #{destination} THEN NULL ELSE places END, package_id = CASE WHEN destination <> #{destination} THEN NULL ELSE package_id END, title = #{title}, departure = #{departure}, destination = #{destination}, is_domestic = #{isDomestic}, style = #{style}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.sql: cost_id, goal_id, flight_cost, hotel_cost, living_cost, total_cost, remaining_budget, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_cost (goal_id, flight_cost, hotel_cost, living_cost, total_cost, remaining_budget, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES (#{goalId}, #{flightCost}, #{hotelCost}, #{livingCost}, #{totalCost}, #{remainingBudget}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_cost SET flight_cost = #{flightCost}, hotel_cost = #{hotelCost}, living_cost = #{livingCost}, total_cost = #{totalCost}, remaining_budget = #{remainingBudget}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE cost_id = #{costId} AND goal_id = #{goalId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM travel_cost WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND goal_id = #{goalId} ORDER BY cost_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE #{quarter} WHEN 1 THEN q1_cost WHEN 2 THEN q2_cost WHEN 3 THEN q3_cost WHEN 4 THEN q4_cost END FROM flight_cost WHERE city_cost_id = #{cityCostId} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE #{quarter} WHEN 1 THEN q1_cost WHEN 2 THEN q2_cost WHEN 3 THEN q3_cost WHEN 4 THEN q4_cost END FROM hotel_cost WHERE city_cost_id = #{cityCostId} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: package_id, goods_code, country, region_name, name, image_url, description, min_price, departure_period, crawled_at, is_active, detail_url, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM travel_package WHERE goods_code = #{goodsCode} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY package_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM travel_package WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND is_active = TRUE AND region_name = #{destination} AND departure_period LIKE CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(#{departureDate}, '%Y.%m.%d'), ' ~ %') AND min_price < #{maxPrice} ORDER BY min_price ASC, crawled_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_package (goods_code, country, region_name, name, image_url, description, min_price, departure_period, crawled_at, is_active, detail_url, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES (#{goodsCode}, #{country}, #{regionName}, #{name}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{minPrice}, #{departurePeriod}, NOW(), TRUE, #{detailUrl}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_package SET country = #{country}, region_name = #{regionName}, name = #{name}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, description = #{description}, min_price = #{minPrice}, departure_period = #{departurePeriod}, crawled_at = NOW(), is_active = TRUE, detail_url = #{detailUrl}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE package_id = #{packageId} AND del_yn = 'N'
UPDATE travel_goal SET package_id = #{packageId}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT insurance_id, title, insurance_inf, insurance_period, insurance_url, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM travel_insurance WHERE del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY insurance_id

SELECT saving_id AS savingId, product_type AS productType, is_active AS isActive, fin_prdt_cd AS finPrdtCd, kor_co_nm AS korCoNm, product_name AS productName, join_member AS joinMember, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm AS saveTrm, basic_rate AS basicRate, max_rate AS maxRate, is_tax_exempt AS isTaxExempt, gov_match_rate AS govMatchRate, product_link AS productLink FROM ( SELECT saving_product.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fin_prdt_cd ORDER BY max_rate DESC, save_trm DESC ) AS rowNumber FROM saving_product WHERE fin_prdt_cd LIKE CONCAT(#{codePrefix}, '%') AND product_type = 'SAVING' AND is_active = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N' ) ranked WHERE rowNumber = 1 ORDER BY max_rate DESC, product_name
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_goal SET status = 'ARCHIVED', modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND del_yn = 'N'
